description:
A young man who saved Princess Le Aina when robbed in the middle of the road. Now the young man is appointed to the Royal Knights for his honor and courage to save and sacrifice his life to save Princess Le Aina. The young man is very happy together with the beautiful Maid and sweet Princess Lolippai.

Note: Lolippai meaning Loli that has big breasts

(Source: Nekopoi and Has Been Translated)
